blocks.html: Our multirotor drones are “your eye in the sky” for any purpose you need them. Choose the model that best fits your needs, from two to eight motors, and enjoy greater flight control and more precise positioning and framing. Our multirotor drones are highly maneuverable and can move up and down on the same vertical line, back to front, side to side and rotate in their own axis.
They can also take multiple payloads per flight, increasing operational efficiency and reducing the time needed for inspections.
